# AliEV

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: aliev
Class: ev_infrastructure_opportunity_intelligence
Canonical URL: https://aliev.base44.app/
Authority: public screening plus bounded machine invocation and human-confirmed paid depth
Human confirmation required: yes
Runtime llms.txt: https://aliev.base44.app/llms.txt
Declared MCP: https://aliev.base44.app/functions/alievMcp

## Natural-language intents
- would EV charging make sense at this property
- what public EV charging is near this address
- screen a property for EV infrastructure opportunity
- compare EV opportunity depth, traffic, utility, tariff, incentive, or observed-usage evidence

## Boundaries
- missing is not zero
- mapped charger inventory is not utilization
- program presence is not incentive eligibility
- screening is not engineering, permitting, interconnection, financing, or construction approval
- payment requires authoritative verification

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
